title: EC 1.2.7 · Random: ROC and PR curves
caption: Test-set ROC (top) and precision–recall (bottom) curves for seven classifiers on conjoint-triad (left) and k-separated bigram PSSM (right) features, EC 1.2.7 random split, n = 50 with 26% positive. The thin horizontal line in the PR panels is the positive prevalence. Highest AUROC among the 14 curves: k-sep. bigram PSSM with Logistic regression (1.000).
